cases.policy: Permission to recalibrate the scale rests with the duty technician.
Authority to release the tender sits with the harbor launch master.
Do not start the shift if the crew list is stale or the sign-in sheet is missing.
Do not accept the pallet if the seal number differs or the manifest page is torn.
Do not light the kiln if the gas certificate has lapsed or the vent check failed.
Do not seat the group if the deposit is unpaid or the headcount is unconfirmed.
Do not power the stage if the cable inspection is overdue or the ground-fault trip is untested.
Do not dispense if the prescription is expired or the allergy flag is raised.
Do not reveal the bid total unless the procurement officer or the auction clerk approves.
The tasting bar stays closed unless the head brewer or the floor manager unlocks it.
Do not archive the logbook unless the archive committee or the records officer signs off.
Never board the whale-watch deck unless the skipper or the first mate clears the sea state.
Do not unlock the specimen drawer unless the curator or the preparator logs the request.
Divers with a logged checkout may borrow the camera housing.
Renters whose damage deposit is held may park in the covered bay.
Teams holding a valid range card may book the long lane.
Handlers with a current rabies certificate may use the agility ring.
Researchers listed on the protocol may access the sample freezer.
Vendors holding a prepaid permit may occupy the market stall.
Members with an access fob may enter the boathouse.
Clients whose intake form is on file may schedule the float tank.
The trade desk does not settle while the margin call is open or the clearinghouse flag is raised.
Sampling is off limits where the borehole is unsealed or the methane meter reads fault.
Do not assign the corner suite when the wedding block is active or the penthouse floor is in rotation.
The press desk stays dark until the embargo lifts or the wire feed confirms publication.
The draft findings may not circulate beyond the team unless the lead reviewer or the ombudsman clears the wider sharing.
Raw footage is not released unless the field producer or the compliance editor signs the release sheet.
Do not book the long-haul slot unless the route is recertified or the ferry waiver is active.
The cellar door stays shut unless the tasting host or the cellar hand is rostered on.
Analysts who cleared the probity check are authorized to sign the exposure memo.
Cafes with a current hygiene rating can display the inspection certificate.
Guards holding a firearm endorsement are permitted to staff the armored gate.
Vets enrolled in the recall program may order the trace serum.
Members of the gliding club who completed the spin training can fly the single-seater.
Subscribers whose payment cleared are entitled to unlock the premium tier.
Do not forward the contract and the exhibits.
Do not copy the master tape and the log sheet.
Do not archive the consent letter and the biopsy report at the end of the visit.
Do not shred the draft affidavit and the exhibit bundle during the case review.
The crane pad may be released once the load test is signed off.
You may open the trading floor once the regulator's letter arrives.
Do not cancel the mooring booking and the haul-out booking.
Do not laminate the certificate and the appendix.
Do not mute the stage channel and the house channel.
Do not veto the flavor batch and the label proof.
You may trim the hedge before the nesting survey begins.
The slip may be reassigned once the waitlist closes.
The skid trail may be reopened after the geotech report lands.
At most three sample reruns are allowed per assay.
At most one name change is honored per season.
The climb may proceed only if the route is flagged open and the weather window is green.
Do not start the pour unless the formwork passed inspection and the batch ticket matches.
The certificate may be reissued if and only if the continuing-education credits are recorded.
If the duplicate key is logged, the locksmith may cut a replacement.
The engine test cell may be run only when the exhaust scrubber is active.
Do not exceed the sound curfew unless the festival committee grants an extension.
Failure to obtain the export licence blocks the shipment; the file may not proceed in any form.
A student may withdraw their own application only.
The pilot who filed the flight plan may cancel it, no one else.
Requests that cite the archive case number may be expedited by the records clerk.
Entries that list a co-author and that lack the ethics clearance may not be submitted.
Issue the badge either as a sticker or as a card — never both for one visitor.
The settlement is paid by wire or by voucher, never by both on one account.
The tonnage figure must be read from the weighbridge ticket alone.
Report the outage count exactly as the network monitor states it.
The wash log must show the drum count.
The dive log must record the bottom time.
The night override may be granted only after the load forecast is published.
The interlock key is never to leave the control room.
Always initial the control sheet before the shift change.
At most two escalations may be parked per queue, regardless of who parked them.
Payment goes out by cheque or by bank transfer; splitting one invoice across both is not allowed.
The archive lift has one rule. It does not run while the fire panel is isolated, and that stand-down holds until the panel is restored and the restoration is logged.
Grading follows a strict order here. The practical is marked only once the safety round is signed, and never before the written sheet is filed.
Two things gate the preview build: the encryption toggle is on and the privacy scan came back empty. Until both hold, the build stays internal.
Applications that involve a minor participant and that lack the guardian's countersignature must not be processed.
Returns that were bought on the corporate card which the employer has since deactivated may not be refunded in cash.
Technicians who skipped the annual recert and who are not on the supervisor's exception list may not touch the reactor bay tools.
Quote the dwell temperature exactly as the kiln controller displays it; handwritten notes are not a source for this figure.
The visitor count is reported from the gate sensor stream alone — headcounts from memory are not acceptable.
The duty groom may hand-feed the new mare.
Senior rangers may lead the night drive.
No one except the blast supervisor may arm the firing circuit.
The foaming line is off limits to everyone but the shift brewer.
Only the lift supervisor may key the hoist override.
The lender will consider the hardship plan only when both the income statement and the affidavit are in the file.
The pit gate opens for the tire crew only after the fueling team and the scrutineers have both cleared the lane.
If either the chiller or the air handler trips, restart the batch line from the top.
Where the motion sensor or the glass-break detector triggers, log the event in the night book.
Either a falling barometer or an ice report is enough to ground the balloon.
Late penalty waivers stay off the table unless the billing desk documents a hardship or the account carries a credit.
The hatch seal is not to be broken unless both the shift lead and the quality officer have logged their consent.
Do not extend the bakery's credit line unless the co-op board or the treasurer renews the guarantee.
Do not purge the visitor logs unless the privacy officer or the retention officer countersigns the purge list.
The cage stays locked unless the animal handler or the attending vet is present.
Deactivation of the alarm zone is reserved to the period when the fire marshal is on site.
Approval of the color change is conditioned solely on the brand board's written nod.
The sole circumstance under which a comp day may be cashed out is a declared staffing emergency.
Reprinting the lost badge is available exclusively where the holder presents a photo ID.
Wherever the pasteurizer logs a clean cycle, the vat may be opened for sampling.
Any courier holding a dock card is entitled to use the freight elevator.
Once the calibration sticker is renewed, the gauge cart may circulate on the floor.
Overtime beyond the roster cap is permitted only in the week a severity call is open.
Filing the incident report and the injury claim in the same envelope is prohibited.
Running the bleach cycle and the dye cycle together in one drum is forbidden.
Publishing the trade figures and the supplier names in a single release is barred.
Shift supervisors may authorize a comp meal.
The observatory director may close the dome early.
Duty pharmacists may draw from the reserve stock.
Only the radiation safety officer may reset the dosimeter badges.
Only the head zookeeper may authorize the enrichment feed.
Only the duty engineer may bypass the interlock.
Authorize the payout only after the auditor and the trustee have both countersigned.
The specimen may leave the lab only if the chain-of-custody form and the courier manifest are complete.
You may book the observatory night only when the weather briefing and the dome inspection are both cleared.
The grant may be drawn down only if the compliance report and the budget variance note are filed.
If the fire alarm or the gas detector sounds, abandon the level immediately.
If the feeder jams or the temperature probe drifts, restart the roasting line.
If either the gate agent or the ramp lead reports a mismatch, hold the flight.
If the tide gauge or the wind sensor flags a limit, suspend the ferry crossing.
Do not waive the restocking fee unless the item arrived damaged or the order was duplicated.
The seal stays on the specimen unless the lab director or the deputy director authorizes removal.
Do not release the escrow unless both the buyer's agent and the seller's agent have confirmed.
The exhibit may not travel unless the conservator and the registrar both approve.
Do not purge the tape backup unless the retention clock has expired.
Keep the batch on hold unless the microbiology panel comes back clear.
You may renew the berth licence only while the marina office is open.
If the escort holds a visitor badge, the delivery van may enter the loading dock.
If the pool log shows balanced chemicals, the swim lane may be opened.
Where the pilot has filed the flight notification, the balloon launch may proceed.
A guest pass may be printed only if the climbing waiver is on file.
The incubator door may be opened only after the humidity cycle has finished.
Overtime may be authorized only when a severity-two incident is active.
The kiln may be opened only while the cooldown indicator is green.
Retake slots may be booked only after the coaching module is complete.
Members may extend the tool loan only if no hold is pending on the item.
The sampling port may be unlocked only where the quarantine flag has been cleared.
If the calibration certificate is current, you may sign the test report.
Do not close the intake form and the consent form in the same batch.
Disclosing the pricing memo and the vendor list in one meeting is prohibited.
Merging the general ledger and the payroll ledger in a single export is forbidden.
Cancelling both the crane booking and the rigging booking on one ticket is barred.
